Garry Drummond, CISSP, CWNA, CWSP, CS50

As a 20-year veteran in the Information Security industry, Garry initially attended Business School in Scotland where he studied Sales and Marketing. His background uniquely combines cross-functional Sales, Marketing and Product Development and Garry is responsible for driving LOCH’s vision for addressing the problem space of Wireless IoT Security for 5G and Cyber-Physical Systems Security. He has been awarded multiple patents related to Wireless IoT Security.

In true Silicon Valley style, Garry boot-strapped LOCH Technologies from his garage. His team have been developing new signal intelligence for securing the Internet of Things and are a Leading Technology Provider in WiFi 6 and 5G Wireless Threat Monitoring and Surveillance. LOCH’s rapid success has led to Silicon Valley Start-up of the Year in April 2015, Silicon Valley Company of the Year in May 2016. In 2017, Garry received the CEO of the Year at the Annual 2017 Global Excellence Awards, hosted by Info Security Products Guide.

Previously, Garry held Senior Sales Leadership roles at nCircle Network Security (acquired by TripWire in 2013) and AirDefense (acquired by Motorola Solutions 2008). In November of 2016, LOCH Technologies received venture capital funding which was used to build a world-class sales and marketing team and a ‘patent awarded’ solution, AirShield(SM).
